meetTheRoutine.title: Meet the routine
meetTheRoutine.instruction: Let three activities finish, then open one Why line.

changeOfPlans.title: Change of plans
changeOfPlans.instruction: Move or add a card, then check what changed in the forecast.

handleTheWrinkle.title: Handle the wrinkle
handleTheWrinkle.instruction: Resolve a wrinkle day without letting anything become urgent.

findTheRhythm.title: Find the rhythm
findTheRhythm.instruction: Choose an intention, then complete one activity it favors that day.

balancedWeek.title: Balanced week
balancedWeek.instruction: For three days, finish two Practice sessions before bed. At each morning check, keep every need at 65 or higher with nothing urgent.

holidaysOver.title: Holiday's over
holidaysOver.instruction: Answer the letter that arrives after your first week.

ui.title: Goals & Journal
ui.routineMemory: Routine memory notices whether Shower or Stretch usually comes first. When both need attention at once, it follows that recent order.

journal.heading: Journal
journal.locked: Finish Meet the routine to open the Journal.
